reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reread the adopted regulations, first-year and route annex, capstone regulations and dated route page before reconsidering the frozen record, exact interest roles, comparative law course evidence, active workbook schedules and cache content.
findings: The complete 60/60/60 EC Nederlands Recht path includes the 5 EC restricted choice and mandatory 10 EC integrated courtroom capstone. The 90 EC threshold is separate from the first-year 45 EC study-advice norm. The common first-year General Law 2 includes the computing practical.

Comparative legal education is meaningful through the breadth of the seven-course law spine, with substantive legal reasoning, legal cases and advanced doctrinal study. It leaves clear gaps in Dutch administrative, civil and criminal progression and legal research. The public/international and technology/governance options have distinct intellectual purposes. Technology offers ethics and computing alongside law but not a complete Dutch technology-law sequence.

The placements respect the current active workbook. Differences are 45, 97.5 and 97.5 EC each way. The foundational law gateway precedes all dependent law work; introductory data work precedes machine learning in the technology option.

The optional independent research item is parallel to the integrated capstone and remains outside the scheduled 180 EC. The official link, all selected descriptions, row names, partial alignments, notes and audience references match their verified intended use.
